verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI at docs.sentry.io/cli for debug information files, releases, source maps and code mappings. It also documents an AI-oriented `npx @sentry/ai install` command that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to install and configure Sentry. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers issue triage or querying for agent workflows, agent-friendly output modes (e.g. JSON), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management, as well as code mappings for other platforms.
One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
